name: com.rewardsfuel/rankfuel
title: RankFuel Leaderboards
description: Free live leaderboards for radio stations and contests: add points, show standings, embed.

tools.name: create_leaderboard
tools.description: Create a free RankFuel leaderboard (rnkfl.com) for radio listeners, no account needed: a public board for an on-air contest (call-ins, trivia, check-ins). Returns the public board URL, studio-screen URL and website embed (URL + iframe HTML), plus a SECRET manage token/URL in the "secret" block: give it only to the person running the board, never post it. Limits: 5 new boards per 10 minutes and 20 per day per connection; up to 500 listeners per board. Free, no key.

station.description: Station name or call sign, e.g. "CFAX 1070" (max 80 characters)

color.description: Optional brand colour as hex, e.g. #e65208 (default #3dd879)

logoUrl.description: Optional https:// link to the station logo image

tools.name: add_points
tools.description: Add (or with a negative number, remove) points for a listener on a RankFuel leaderboard. Needs the board id and its SECRET manage token. The listener is identified by public display name (+ optional town); a new name is added to the board automatically. PRIVACY: names are public, so use a first name plus last initial or a nickname; full names are shortened to "Jane S." and phone numbers or emails are rejected. Returns the listener's new total and rank and the top 10. Free, no key.

boardId.description: Leaderboard id (10 characters) or its public link, e.g. https://rfwin.uk/lb/abc123defg

manageToken.description: SECRET manage token (rlb_…) returned once by create_leaderboard (the manage link also works). Keep private; never show it in public places.

listener.description: Public display name: first name + last initial, or a nickname/handle. No phone numbers or emails.

town.description: Optional town shown on the board; tells same-name listeners apart

reason.description: Optional short label, e.g. call-in, trivia, check-in (max 24 characters)

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Public standings of a RankFuel leaderboard (radio listener board): station, contest, open/closed, ranked listeners (display names, towns, points; ties share a rank), and a ready-to-quote answer with the leader. Use when someone asks "who is winning/leading …" and has an rfwin.uk/lb/<id> link. No token needed. Free, no key.

boardId.description: Leaderboard id (10 characters) or its public link, e.g. https://rfwin.uk/lb/abc123defg

top.description: How many places to return, 1-100 (default 10; listeners tied at the cutoff are included)

tools.name: close_leaderboard
tools.description: Close a RankFuel leaderboard when the contest ends: the public board shows final standings and no more points can be added. Pass reopen: true to reopen. Needs the SECRET manage token. Free, no key.

boardId.description: Leaderboard id (10 characters) or its public link, e.g. https://rfwin.uk/lb/abc123defg

manageToken.description: SECRET manage token (rlb_…) returned once by create_leaderboard (the manage link also works). Keep private; never show it in public places.

reopen.description: true reopens a closed board (default false = close)
